source.original_question:
As shown in the picture, When foot D touches the ground, the head point E rises ()
Choices:
A:0.5m
B:0.6m
C:0.3m
D:0.9m

adaptations.reason: Decorative photograph, person, tree or building texture removed; the mathematical segments, endpoints, measurements, directions and source layout are reconstructed natively.

independent_solution.method: Sin of the board tilt=AB/AD=0.3/0.6=1/2. EndpointE rises from pivot level by AE*sin=1/2=0.5m.
